responses.evidence: Cleared by the clear condition's branch (b): B-07's observable is restated at an in-scope seam and src/orchestrator.test.ts stays out of the file scope, so the spawned-scenario non-goal is untouched. B-07 now declares a source-position assertion in src/mutation-report.test.ts — in the shape of src/eval-boundary.test.ts:166-183's P-01 case, which reads a source file as text and compares indexOf positions with toBeLessThan — that pins, over src/orchestrator.ts's text: `assertWithinManifestScope({` (:8501) < the refusal call site < `const initialized = updateRunState(` (:8509) < `runLaunchPreflight(` (:8545) < `runWave(` (:9178). Verified in this worktree that each of those three trailing anchors occurs exactly once in src/orchestrator.ts (`const initialized = updateRunState(` at line 8509, `runLaunchPreflight(` at line 8545, `runWave(` at line 9178, count 1 each), so every position is unambiguous and the ordering is satisfiable with plain indexOf. That ordering carries the full AC2 claim: the refusal precedes the run's first run-state mutation, precedes the launch preflight — which is why --preflight-report-only cannot bypass it, since the flag only downgrades PreflightFindings emitted by a preflight that has not yet run (B-06, P-04, ADR 0042) — and precedes runWave(, at or after which every worktree creation, branch creation and agent dispatch happens. The refusal reason itself remains B-06's assertion in src/preflight.test.ts. The manifest's B-07 observableResult names src/mutation-report.test.ts and src/preflight.test.ts explicitly, both of which are in fileScope.paths, and states that src/orchestrator.test.ts is not in scope and no test drives runPipeline. The matching Test plan bullet and Definition of done item were rewritten to the same terms. Note for the record: acceptance-manifest.json was absent from this worktree at the start of this round (only context.md, contract.md, contract-review.json and feedback-r1.md were present), so the manifest was written in full from the contract's terms rather than edited in place; every non-routed behavior entry restates the round-1 contract text it binds and no scope term, migration count (0), gate binding or behavior ID changed.

B-13 now names the identifier: the run-ID provenance value is the run's `runSlug` — the provider-qualified slug runSlugForProviderName produces (src/run-identity.ts:23) — and the contract states that this is already the string the ship gate receives on RunShipGateArgs (verified: `runSlug: string;` at src/ship-gate.ts:584, destructured at :660) and already the key updateRunState writes the state file under (verified: the `runSlug: string` parameter at src/run-state.ts:1389 feeding updateRunState at :1394), so no new identifier is minted. B-13's reader clause and the manifest's B-13 observableResult now say the src/run-state.test.ts write->load round-trip through adaptLoadedState compares the loaded provenance value against the runSlug the record was written under, rather than asserting field presence; the Test plan bullet, the Definition of done item and the New patterns section carry the same value. No other B-13 term moved: the RUN_STATE_VERSION 6 -> 7 bump, the widened 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 union, the additive RunEventPayload member at EVENTS_SCHEMA_VERSION 1, and the two authorized hard pins (src/run-state.test.ts:990, src/eval-boundary.test.ts:127) are unchanged.
